messages:
Devon (Customer): Hey team — tried to apply promo code XMAS2025 during account sign-up but it silently didn’t apply. UI shows free trial credits = $0 and billing page shows tax_country=IN, currency=INR. No error shown, just no credits. Can someone check?

Rita (Support): Thanks for flagging, Devon. Can you paste the account id and the exact steps you took? Also, did you enter a VAT/GST number on the billing form? :thinking_face:

Devon (Customer): account_01234_IN. Steps: signup -> enter card -> promo XMAS2025 -> click apply -> toast says "Applied" for 0.5s then disappears. I did NOT enter GSTIN. I’m in Mumbai. Screenshot attached.

Rita (Support): Got it — reproducing quickly on our side. Sam (Billing) looping in. At a glance it looks like promo eligibility check may be rejecting accounts with tax_country set to non-US + currency != USD. Sam, can you pull promo-engine logs for promo=XMAS2025 and account_01234_IN?

Sam (Billing): Pulling logs now. BillingBot: generated a webhook to promo-engine. Log excerpt: `promo_apply attempt: promo=XMAS2025 account=account_01234_IN currency=INR tax_present=false gst_in=null eligibility=false reason=region_currency_blacklist`. Hmm. That `region_currency_blacklist` string is new.

Natalie (Engineer): Thanks — I’m checking code. Promo service has a legacy rule added during last Black Friday: we blackout promos for non-USD currencies unless a tax_flag is explicitly set to allow. Bug here: onboarding sets tax_present=false by default and we don't surface that to promo service, so INR accounts fall through. Repro steps for engineers:
```
# reproduce locally
POST /v1/promos/apply { "promo": "XMAS2025", "account": "account_01234_IN" }
# headers: X-Region: AP-SOUTH1; X-Currency: INR
# expect: 200 with credits
# actual: 200 with { "applied": false, "reason": "region_currency_blacklist" }
```

Rita (Support): Devon — sorry for the friction. Short-term workaround: Sam can grant the trial credits manually to your account while we fix the rule. Sam?

Sam (Billing): I can grant credits. I’ll issue 500 credits (equivalent to the promo) to account_01234_IN and mark as manual_promo_grant. Creating a billing ticket #BILL-9872. Devon, you’ll see the credits in the console in ~1 minute. Also adding note to exempt your account from the fraud/regional block.

Devon (Customer): Thanks, I see the credits now. Appreciate the quick turnaround. Any ETA on the permanent fix?

Natalie (Engineer): Patch plan: remove the blacklist rule and replace with an allowlist tied to explicit tax-exempt flag. Backfill: treat accounts with currency != USD as eligible unless tax_compliance flag says otherwise. I’ll open PR now. Target deploy: next canary in ~4 hours, full rollout tomorrow. Will post PR link.

Sam (Billing): BillingBot created ticket BILL-9872 and applied 500 credits. Note: if customer later adds GSTIN, we’ll re-evaluate tax treatment but credits remain.

Rita (Support): Marking this thread as resolved for now — manual credit applied. Natalie, once PR is merged, please post the commit/PR link here and we’ll close the billing ticket. Devon, if anything odd happens with usage or invoices let us know and we’ll reopen. :thumbsup:

Natalie (Engineer): PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/promo-service/pull/423 — fixes region/currency handling and adds unit tests around GST/GSTIN flows. Will update deploy status in #eng-releases.

Devon (Customer): Verified promo behavior in console after credits applied. Thanks everyone!

Rita (Support): Closing thread — follow-ups in BILL-9872 and PR.
